title: The Multigenerational Effects of Legal Access to the Pill on Infant Health
title_primary: The Multigenerational Effects of Legal Access to the Pill on Infant Health
authors: Hamid Noghanibehambari, David Slusky, Erdal Tekin, Hoa Vu
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine whether expanded legal access to the contraceptive pill for minors generated health benefits for subsequent generations. We use data from the restricted-use Natality files from 1970-2020, linking mothers to the level of access to the pill in their state and year of birth and the extent to which their mothers could access the pill as minors. Our results show that children whose mothers were born after expanded access to the pill as minors had better birth outcomes, with gains concentrated among Black families. Among affected births, legalization increased birth weight by 12-16 grams and reduced incidence of low birth weight by 2.7-3.4 percent. These magnitudes have economic significance, corresponding to approximately $113.8–$115.3 million in medical cost savings, measured in 2025 dollars, for the 2000 Black birth cohort alone. Our mechanism analysis points to a postponement of early childbearing by the generation directly affected by legal access to the pill as minors whose daughters subsequently attained higher levels of education, used more prenatal care, and had longer birth spacing. Taken together, our results suggest that reproductive health policy can generate multigenerational benefits and contribute to reductions in racial disparities in early-life health.

title: Downton Revisited: Income Shocks and Aristocratic Marriage Markets, 1840–1913
title_zh: 唐顿再探：收入冲击与贵族婚姻市场，1840–1913
title_primary: 唐顿再探：收入冲击与贵族婚姻市场，1840–1913
title_secondary: Downton Revisited: Income Shocks and Aristocratic Marriage Markets, 1840–1913
authors: Mark Taylor
official: 官方在线 2026-08-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a transferable-utility model in which the collapse of arable estate income reshaped the aristocratic marriage market. The model predicts two cash-for-prestige substitution channels: a durable senior shift toward American brides, especially liquid new-money fortunes, and a transitory junior shift toward British commercial commoners, whose wealth scaled only weakly with rank. Analyzing 6,018 aristocratic marriages over 1840–1913, we combine trend-adjusted time-series evidence with cross-sectional exposure gradients in estate value and family size. American marriages rise as real wheat prices fall, especially among senior, larger-estate, and larger-family peers; new-money brides rise from 20% to 60% of classified American matches.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个可转移效用模型，其中农业地产收入的崩溃重塑了贵族婚姻市场。该模型预测了两种以金钱换取声望的替代渠道：一种是对美国新娘，特别是流动性强的新贵财富的持久性高级别转向；另一种是对英国商业平民的短暂性低级别转向，后者的财富与等级关联度较弱。通过分析1840年至1913年间6018桩贵族婚姻，我们结合了趋势调整的时间序列证据与地产价值和家庭规模方面的横截面暴露梯度。随着实际小麦价格下降，美国婚姻数量上升，尤其在高级别、大地产业和大家庭的贵族中更为显著；新贵新娘在分类的美国婚姻匹配中占比从20%升至60%。

title: The ontological dimensions of coastal mangrove reserve conflicts——insights from China
title_zh: 中国沿海红树林保护区冲突的本体论维度——来自中国的启示
title_primary: 中国沿海红树林保护区冲突的本体论维度——来自中国的启示
title_secondary: The ontological dimensions of coastal mangrove reserve conflicts——insights from China
authors: Shuning Zhu, Annah Lake Zhu, Weiye Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In the context of escalating anthropogenic pressures on coastal ecosystems, this article employs a case study of one of China’s southeastern coastal mangrove reserves to interrogate the interplay between local communities and state authorities in natural resource governance from an ontological perspective. Through qualitative research involving 30 semi-structured interviews conducted between 2019 and 2023, we reveal how state, market, and community actors operate from fundamentally different – and often incompatible – understandings of mangroves. We trace a historical shift from a community ontology, where mangroves were perceived as socio-ecological commons buffering against flooding, to a market ontology through which mangroves were seen as barriers to marketized aquaculture development. While state intervention later curtailed market overexploitation, its regulatory, ecological ontology clashed with both the eroded community framework and the persistent market logic. Consequently, state governance, though justified by ecologically necessity, proved ontologically irreconcilable with the community’s original, relational approach. This study demonstrates that environmental governance conflicts are not merely about resource distribution but are rooted in conflicting ontologies and clashes between divergent world-making practices. It thus contributes a novel analytical lens for understanding governance conflicts in socio-ecological systems under competing state and market pressures, revealing that effective and just governance requires recognizing and navigating deep ontological divides, not just negotiating resource claims.
abstract_zh: 在沿海生态系统面临日益加剧的人为压力背景下，本文以中国东南沿海一处红树林保护区为案例，从本体论视角探讨自然资源治理中地方社区与国家权力之间的互动关系。通过2019年至2023年间开展的30次半结构化访谈的定性研究，我们揭示了国家、市场与社区行动者如何基于根本不同且往往互不相容的红树林理解方式运作。我们追溯了从社区本体论——红树林被视为抵御洪水的社会-生态共有资源——向市场本体论——红树林被视为市场化水产养殖发展的障碍——的历史转变。尽管国家干预后来遏制了市场的过度开发，但其监管性的生态本体论与已被侵蚀的社区框架及持续存在的市场逻辑均发生冲突。因此，国家治理虽以生态必要性为正当性依据，却在本体论上与社区原有的关系性路径无法调和。本研究表明，环境治理冲突不仅关乎资源分配，更根植于相互冲突的本体论及不同世界建构实践之间的碰撞。由此，本研究为理解国家与市场压力并存下社会-生态系统中的治理冲突提供了新的分析视角，揭示出有效且公正的治理不仅需要协商资源诉求，更需要识别并驾驭深层的本体论分歧。

title: Robust Signal Maximization in Spillover Experiments
title_zh: 溢出实验中稳健信号最大化
title_primary: 溢出实验中稳健信号最大化
title_secondary: Robust Signal Maximization in Spillover Experiments
authors: Kirill Borusyak, Peter Hull, Evan M. Munro
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the optimal design and analysis of experiments for estimating spillover effects. Assuming a known (e.g., linear) exposure mapping, we characterize the treatment-assignment distribution and regression-based estimator that minimize worst-case asymptotic variance against a broad class of distributions of unobservables. The design problem yields an intuitive solution in which the planner trades off spillover signal strength against diffusion of spillover variation. The analysis problem yields a simple recentered instrumental variable estimator to best leverage this variation. This framework produces natural solutions in several benchmark cases -- such as clustered exposure-- and suggests computationally tractable approximations for general networks, including bipartite settings. We illustrate these new tools in semi-synthetic experiments based on two applications from development economics. Our approach yields large standard error reductions in both experiments, increasing effective sample sizes by 50–100% or more.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了在估计溢出效应时实验的最优设计与分析。假设暴露映射已知（例如线性），我们刻画了处理分配分布及基于回归的估计量，这些能在广泛的不可观测变量分布类别中最小化最坏情况下的渐近方差。设计问题给出了一个直观的解决方案，其中规划者在溢出信号强度与溢出变异扩散之间进行权衡。分析问题则产生了一个简单的重新中心化工具变量估计量，以最佳利用这种变异。该框架在几个基准情形下——如聚类暴露——提供了自然解决方案，并为一般网络（包括二分设置）提出了计算上可行的近似方法。我们基于发展经济学的两个应用在半合成实验中展示了这些新工具。我们的方法在两个实验中均大幅降低了标准误，使有效样本量增加了50%至100%或更多。

title: Techies and Firm‐Level Productivity
title_zh: 技术人员与企业生产率
title_primary: 技术人员与企业生产率
title_secondary: Techies and Firm‐Level Productivity
authors: James Harrigan, Ariell Reshef, Farid Toubal
official: 官方在线 2026-08-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the impact of techies—engineers and other technically trained workers—on firm‐level productivity. We first report new facts on techies in the firm using French administrative data. Techies are STEM‐skill intensive and associated with innovation, technology adoption, management, and diffusion within firms. Using structural econometric methods, we estimate the effect of techies on firm‐level Hicks‐neutral productivity in manufacturing and nonmanufacturing. We find that techies raise productivity, and that this effect goes beyond R&D workers, extending to ICT and other techies. In nonmanufacturing firms, the impact operates mostly through ICT and other techies, not R&D workers.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了技术人员——工程师及其他受过技术训练的工人——对企业层面生产率的影响。首先，我们利用法国行政数据报告了关于企业内部技术人员的新事实。技术人员高度集中于STEM技能，并与企业内部的创新、技术采纳、管理及知识扩散相关联。运用结构计量经济学方法，我们估算了技术人员对制造业和非制造业企业层面希克斯中性生产率的影响。我们发现技术人员能提升生产率，且这一效应超越了研发人员，延伸至信息技术及其他技术人员。在非制造业企业中，该影响主要通过信息技术及其他技术人员发挥作用，而非研发人员。

title: Worker Skills, Firm Dynamics, and Productivity
title_zh: 工人技能、企业动态与生产率
title_primary: 工人技能、企业动态与生产率
title_secondary: Worker Skills, Firm Dynamics, and Productivity
authors: İlhan Güner, Christian Siegel
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: 官方在线 2026-08-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model of firm dynamics with multiple labour skills to analyse the productivity implications of skill shortages. Firms employ cognitive, interpersonal, and manual skills in both operational and overhead tasks, with sectoral variation in skill intensities, and within sector firm size heterogeneity due to idiosyncratic technology draws. Calibrated to UK data, the model reveals that cognitive skills are a binding constraint on productivity. A reduction in the supply of cognitive skills lowers labour productivity at all levels – firms, sectors, and in the aggregate. About half of the sectoral effects are due to changes in the within-sector distribution, whereby larger firms grow in relative size but become less productive. Sectoral heterogeneity in skill intensities amplifies these effects.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含多种劳动技能的企业动态一般均衡模型，以分析技能短缺对生产率的影响。企业将认知、人际交往和手工技能用于运营及管理任务，各行业在技能密集度上存在差异，且行业内企业规模因特有技术冲击而呈现异质性。基于英国数据的校准结果显示，认知技能是生产率的约束性瓶颈。认知技能供给的减少会降低企业、行业及总体层面的劳动生产率。约一半的行业效应源于行业内分布的变化，即大型企业相对规模扩大但生产率下降。行业间技能密集度的异质性加剧了这些影响。

title: Reproducible Aggregation of Sample-Split Statistics
title_zh: 样本分裂统计量的可复现聚合
title_primary: 样本分裂统计量的可复现聚合
title_secondary: Reproducible Aggregation of Sample-Split Statistics
authors: Ritzwoller, David M., Romano, Joseph P.
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Statistical inference is often simplified by sample-splitting. This simplification comes at the cost of the introduction of randomness not native to the data. We propose a simple procedure for sequentially aggregating statistics constructed with multiple splits of the same sample. The user specifies a bound and a nominal error rate. If the procedure is implemented twice on the same data, the nominal error rate approximates the chance that the results differ by more than the bound. We illustrate the application of the procedure to several widely applied econometric methods.
abstract_zh: 统计推断常因样本分割而简化，但这种简化以引入数据本身不具备的随机性为代价。我们提出一种简单程序，用于顺序聚合基于同一份样本多次分割构建的统计量。用户需指定一个界限和名义错误率。若该程序在同一数据上实施两次，名义错误率近似于两次结果差异超过该界限的概率。我们展示了该程序在几种广泛应用的计量经济学方法中的适用性。

title: (Un)equal and safe: How distributional and defense information shape fuel tax support?
title_zh: （不）平等与安全：分配与防御信息如何影响燃油税支持？
title_primary: （不）平等与安全：分配与防御信息如何影响燃油税支持？
title_secondary: (Un)equal and safe: How distributional and defense information shape fuel tax support?
authors: Ausrine Dirzinskaite, Laura Galdikiene
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Carbon taxation is one of the most effective tools for reducing emissions, but it often faces public resistance due to concerns about fairness, distributional impacts, and the use of revenue. Experimental evidence on how these factors shape tax acceptance remains limited, particularly outside North America and Western Europe. This study examines how information emphasizing the progressive features of a fuel tax—a proxy for carbon taxation—affects perceptions of fairness and tax acceptance. It also investigates, for the first time, how allocating tax revenue to national defense, at a time when this issue is highly salient, influences tax acceptance. Drawing on Lithuania’s 2025 fuel tax increase, which was partially earmarked for defense spending, we conducted an online survey experiment (N = 2553). Respondents were assigned to one of three conditions: (1) information on the tax’s distributional effects, emphasizing its progressiveness; (2) the same information plus a reminder about revenue allocation to defense; or (3) no information. Providing distributional information, both on its own and in combination with a reminder that revenues would be allocated to defense spending, increased perceived fairness and self-reported support for the tax. Moreover, the combined treatment reduced opposition to the tax. The defense-earmarking reminder also made an independent contribution to reducing opposition. Overall, the results suggest that both distributional considerations and the intended use of revenues shape public acceptance of the policy.
abstract_zh: 碳税是减少排放最有效的工具之一，但因其公平性、分配影响及收入用途方面的担忧，常常面临公众阻力。关于这些因素如何影响税收接受度的实验证据仍然有限，尤其是在北美和西欧以外的地区。本研究考察了强调燃油税（作为碳税的代理指标）累进特征的信息如何影响公平感及税收接受度。同时，本研究首次探讨了在国防问题高度突出的时期，将税收收入分配给国防如何影响税收接受度。基于立陶宛2025年燃油税上调（部分指定用于国防支出），我们开展了一项在线调查实验（N = 2553）。受访者被分配到三种条件之一：（1）关于税收分配效应的信息，强调其累进性；（2）相同信息加上税收收入用于国防的提醒；（3）无信息。提供分配信息，无论是单独提供还是与收入将用于国防支出的提醒相结合，均提高了感知公平性和对税收的自我报告支持度。此外，联合处理减少了对税收的反对。国防指定用途的提醒也对减少反对做出了独立贡献。总体而言，结果表明，分配考量与收入的预期用途共同塑造了公众对该政策的接受度。

title: Pension Liquidity Risk
title_zh: 养老金流动性风险
title_primary: 养老金流动性风险
title_secondary: Pension Liquidity Risk
authors: Kristy A E Jansen, Sven Klingler, Angelo Ranaldo, Patty Duijm
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Pension funds use interest rate swaps to hedge the interest rate risk arising from their liabilities. Analyzing regulatory data on Dutch pension funds, we show that pension funds with worse funding ratios, indicating greater fragility, use swaps more aggressively. These swap positions expose pension funds to the risk of margin calls, which can exceed 6% of their total assets, when interest rates rise. Pension funds respond to realized margin calls by selling safe government bonds with medium-term maturities. This procyclical selling behavior adversely affects the prices of the sold bonds and thereby exposes pension funds to market liquidity risk. (JEL E43, G12, G18)
abstract_zh: 养老基金利用利率互换来对冲其负债产生的利率风险。通过分析荷兰养老基金的监管数据，我们发现，资金状况较差（即脆弱性更高）的养老基金更激进地使用互换。这些互换头寸使养老基金面临追加保证金的风险，当利率上升时，追加金额可能超过其总资产的6%。面对已实现的保证金追缴，养老基金通过出售中期安全政府债券来应对。这种顺周期抛售行为对出售债券的价格产生不利影响，从而使养老基金面临市场流动性风险。（JEL E43, G12, G18）

title: A Demand-Side Alternative to Renewable Curtailment: Natural Field Experimental Evidence from Two Countries
title_zh: 可再生能源弃电的需求侧替代方案：来自两国的自然实地实验证据
title_primary: 可再生能源弃电的需求侧替代方案：来自两国的自然实地实验证据
title_secondary: A Demand-Side Alternative to Renewable Curtailment: Natural Field Experimental Evidence from Two Countries
authors: Daniel Lopez Garcia, Robert D. Metcalfe, Andrew R. Schein, Yixin Sun
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: As renewable generation plays a growing role in the energy system, periods of negative wholesale electricity prices are becoming increasingly common and are expected to grow dramatically over the next ten years. Traditionally, system operators respond by paying generators, especially renewables, to curtail production, or mandating that they do so without compensation. In this study, we propose and test a novel alternative: exposing consumers to free and negative prices to stimulate demand when supply is abundant. We implemented large-scale nationwide natural field experiments simultaneously in Great Britain and Spain, with roughly 60,000 residential customers in each country randomized to receive varying financial incentives to “turn up” their electricity. We found that demand increased substantially as prices fell to zero, but paying customers to consume beyond zero price yielded little additional response. Households with electric vehicles and rooftop solar had a larger elasticity than households without such technologies, suggesting demand turn-up becomes more effective as households adopt low-carbon technologies. In Great Britain, consumption was largely shifted from adjacent hours, while in Spain the increase appeared to represent net new demand. We develop a welfare framework showing conditions under which demand turn-up improves on curtailment; we find that by inducing additional consumption in periods and locations where the marginal cost of supply is low, demand turn-up generates welfare gains that curtailment leaves uncaptured.
abstract_zh: 随着可再生能源在能源系统中扮演日益重要的角色，负批发电价现象正变得愈发普遍，预计未来十年将大幅增长。传统上，系统运营商会通过向发电商（尤其是可再生能源发电商）支付费用要求其削减产量，或强制其无偿减产来应对这一情况。本研究提出并检验了一种创新替代方案：在供应充裕时，通过向消费者提供零电价甚至负电价来刺激需求。我们在英国和西班牙同步开展了大规模全国性自然现场实验，每个国家约有6万户居民被随机分配接受不同力度的经济激励，以"提升"其用电量。研究发现，当电价降至零时，需求显著增长；但通过付费激励消费者在零电价基础上进一步增加用电，收效甚微。拥有电动汽车和屋顶太阳能的家庭需求弹性显著高于未配备此类技术的家庭，这表明随着家庭采用低碳技术，"需求提升"策略将更为有效。在英国，用电增量主要来自相邻时段的用电转移；而在西班牙，用电增长则表现为净新增需求。我们构建了一个福利分析框架，揭示了"需求提升"优于"削减产量"的条件：通过在供应边际成本较低的时段和区域诱导额外消费，"需求提升"能够产生"削减产量"策略无法实现的福利增益。

title: Relating Cognitive Skills and Personality Traits to Economic Preferences: Decision-Making under Cognitive Shocks and Guessing
title_zh: 认知技能与人格特质对经济偏好的影响：认知冲击与猜测情境下的决策行为
title_primary: 认知技能与人格特质对经济偏好的影响：认知冲击与猜测情境下的决策行为
title_secondary: Relating Cognitive Skills and Personality Traits to Economic Preferences: Decision-Making under Cognitive Shocks and Guessing
authors: Cesar Chavez Padilla, Shuaizhang Feng, James J. Heckman, Zhe Yang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using rich data on Chinese schoolchildren, we study the relationships of IQ and personality traits with children’s risk preferences and how they affect the precision with which those preferences are measured. Our structural model separates preferences from deliberation noise and guessing, and relates guessing to deliberation noise. Psychological measures have weak direct influences on preferences but strongly affect deliberation noise and guessing behavior. Shocks to choice have persistent individual-specific components and are not independent. Socioeconomic background has little direct influence on preferences or deliberation noise once traits are accounted for. Background variables affect psychological traits, however. Risk preferences differ across and within genders. For small gambles, girls are less risk averse than boys, but the opposite holds for larger gambles.
abstract_zh: 基于中国学龄儿童的丰富数据，本研究探讨了智商与人格特质与儿童风险偏好之间的关系，以及这些因素如何影响风险偏好测量的精确度。我们的结构模型将偏好与决策噪声及猜测行为区分开来，并将猜测行为与决策噪声相关联。心理测量指标对偏好的直接影响较弱，但显著影响决策噪声与猜测行为。选择中的冲击具有持久的个体特异性成分，且并非相互独立。在控制心理特质后，社会经济背景对偏好或决策噪声的直接作用微乎其微。然而，背景变量会影响心理特质。风险偏好存在性别间及性别内的差异。对于小额赌博，女孩的风险厌恶程度低于男孩；但对于大额赌博，情况则相反。

title: Second Order Approximation of Dynamic Models with Time-Varying Risk
title_zh: 时变风险动态模型的二阶近似
title_primary: 时变风险动态模型的二阶近似
title_secondary: Second Order Approximation of Dynamic Models with Time-Varying Risk
authors: Pierpaolo Benigno, Gianluca Benigno, Salvatore Nistico, Philip Coyle, Naoki Maezono 等
official: 官方在线 2011-01-03 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper provides first and second-order approximation methods for the solution of non-linear dynamic stochastic models in which the exogenous state variables follow conditionally-linear stochastic processes displaying time-varying risk. The first-order approximation is consistent with a conditionally-linear model in which risk is still time-varying but has no distinct role - separated from the primitive stochastic disturbances- in influencing the endogenous variables. The second-order approximation of the solution, instead, is sufficient to get this role. Moreover, risk premia, evaluated using only a first-order approximation of the solution, will be also time varying.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了求解非线性动态随机模型的一阶和二阶近似方法，其中外生状态变量遵循具有时变风险的条件线性随机过程。一阶近似与条件线性模型一致，在该模型中风险虽仍具有时变性，但在影响内生变量方面并未发挥独立于原始随机扰动的独特作用。而解的二阶近似则足以体现这一作用。此外，仅使用解的一阶近似评估的风险溢价也将呈现时变性。

title: Tariffs, production networks, and spillovers: the case of a US-China trade war
title_zh: 关税、生产网络与溢出效应：以中美贸易战为例
title_primary: 关税、生产网络与溢出效应：以中美贸易战为例
title_secondary: Tariffs, production networks, and spillovers: the case of a US-China trade war
authors: Aguilar, Pablo, Darracq Pariès, Matthieu, Dieppe, Alistair, Domínguez-Díaz, Rubén, Gallegos, José-Elías 等
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the short-run macroeconomic transmission of a US–China tariff war in an open economy multi-sector New Keynesian model with input–output linkages, sectoral nominal rigidities, and heterogeneous currency invoicing. A reciprocal 10 percentage-point tariff increase generates asymmetric incidence: the tariff-imposing country bears more of the inflationary burden, while the targeted country experiences the larger output contraction. Production networks amplify this contraction by propagating the shock beyond the directly tariffed bilateral margin. Currency invoicing further shapes transmission. Under heterogeneous invoicing, dollar-priced border prices weaken the expenditure-switching role of exchange rates, deepening the contraction in China relative to producer-currency pricing and altering third-country spillovers. The EA response is small in the aggregate, but only because positive trade-diversion margins are offset by weaker demand from China and multilateral adjustments. We then exploit the model’s sectoral structure by imposing tariffs on one Chinese sector at a time. Sectoral incidence is highly concentrated, but aggregate effects cannot be inferred from the directly tariffed sector alone: domestic propagation offsets own-sector gains in the US, reinforces own-sector losses in China, and leaves the EA as a net object shaped by opposing trade margins. The results show that tariff incidence depends jointly on where the tariff lands, how the shock propagates through production networks, and how invoicing governs border-price adjustment. A framework that combines these margins delivers a materially different assessment from one built on bilateral trade shares alone. JEL Classification: E31, E32, E52, F13, F41, F42
abstract_zh: 我们研究中美关税战在开放经济多部门新凯恩斯模型中的短期宏观经济传导，该模型包含投入产出关联、部门名义刚性和异质性货币计价。互征10个百分点关税会产生不对称的归宿效应：征收关税的国家承担更多通胀压力，而目标国家则经历更大的产出收缩。生产网络通过将冲击传播至直接受关税影响的双边边际之外，放大了这种收缩。货币计价进一步塑造了传导机制。在异质性计价下，美元计价的边境价格削弱了汇率的支出转换作用，相较于生产者货币计价，加深了中国的产出收缩，并改变了第三国的溢出效应。欧元区的总体反应较小，但这仅仅是因为正向的贸易转移边际被来自中国的需求减弱和多边调整所抵消。随后，我们利用模型的部门结构，逐一对中国单个部门征收关税。部门层面的归宿高度集中，但总体效应无法仅从直接受关税影响的部门推断：国内传播抵消了美国本部门的收益，强化了中国本部门的损失，并使欧元区成为由相反贸易边际塑造的净对象。结果表明，关税归宿共同取决于关税落点、冲击通过生产网络的传播方式，以及计价机制如何主导边境价格调整。一个综合这些边际的框架得出的评估，与仅基于双边贸易份额的框架存在实质性差异。JEL分类号：E31, E32, E52, F13, F41, F42

title: Balancing pastoral heritage and tourism – A DRSIR perspective on landscape transformation in European mountains
title_zh: 平衡牧区遗产与旅游业——基于DRSIR视角的欧洲山地景观转型研究
title_primary: 平衡牧区遗产与旅游业——基于DRSIR视角的欧洲山地景观转型研究
title_secondary: Balancing pastoral heritage and tourism – A DRSIR perspective on landscape transformation in European mountains
authors: Michał Sobala, Anna Żemła-Siesicka
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: European mountain areas have been historically shaped by traditional pastoral practices, creating culturally, ecologically, and visually valuable traditional landscapes. Over the past decades, these landscapes have faced profound transformations due to the decline of pastoralism and the rapid development of tourism. This paper applies a modified DPSIR framework, referred to as the DRSIR model, to present driving forces, local reactions, landscape state changes, impacts, and responses related to transformations of pastoral landscape in European mountain regions. The aim of this paper is to present a conceptual synthesis of these transformations based on a literature review and structured using the DRSIR framework. The conceptual synthesis enabled the identification of three landscape transformation models: Co-presence, Sequence, and Abandonment. These models reflect varying degrees of interaction between pastoralism and tourism. Co-presence allows for sustainable coexistence or cooperation between traditional pastoralism and tourism which allows the preservation of traditional landscape features. Sequence models illustrate transitions where one function succeeds or suppresses the other, and abandonment reflects the decline of pastoral practices and tourism, often leading to afforestation and loss of landscape and cultural values. The essay highlights landscape consequences of these trajectories. Management responses, guided by legal protection, agri-environmental policies, and sustainable tourism initiatives, can either prevent abandonment or mitigate negative impacts, shaping future landscape scenarios. The DRSIR framework provides a comprehensive lens for understanding these dynamics, supporting spatial planning and landscape management by enabling the identification of dominant relationships between tourism and pastoralism in different mountain regions. Maintaining the evolutionary continuity of traditional landscapes while integrating pastoralism and tourism functions emerges as a key strategy for preserving European mountain landscapes.
abstract_zh: 欧洲山区历史上深受传统牧业实践的影响，形成了具有文化、生态和视觉价值的传统景观。近几十年来，由于牧业衰退和旅游业快速发展，这些景观经历了深刻变革。本文采用改进的DPSIR框架（即DRSIR模型），系统呈现了欧洲山区牧场景观转型相关的驱动力、地方响应、景观状态变化、影响及应对措施。研究旨在基于文献综述，运用DRSIR框架对这些转型进行概念性综合。该概念综合识别出三种景观转型模式：共存模式、序列模式与废弃模式。这些模式反映了牧业与旅游业之间不同程度的互动关系。共存模式允许传统牧业与旅游业实现可持续共存或合作，从而保留传统景观特征；序列模式呈现一种功能取代或抑制另一种功能的过渡过程；废弃模式则反映牧业与旅游业的双重衰退，常导致森林扩张及景观与文化价值的丧失。本文重点阐述了这些发展轨迹的景观后果。在法律保护、农业环境政策及可持续旅游倡议指导下的管理应对措施，既能防止景观废弃，也能减轻负面影响，从而塑造未来景观格局。DRSIR框架为理解这些动态机制提供了全面视角，通过识别不同山区牧业与旅游业之间的主导关系，支持空间规划与景观管理。在整合牧业与旅游功能的同时，维持传统景观的演化连续性，成为保护欧洲山区景观的关键策略。

title: Technological investment and accounting: A demand-side perspective on labor markets and enrollments
title_zh: 技术投资与会计：劳动力市场与入学率的需求侧视角
title_primary: 技术投资与会计：劳动力市场与入学率的需求侧视角
title_secondary: Technological investment and accounting: A demand-side perspective on labor markets and enrollments
authors: Henry Friedman, Andrew G. Sutherland, Felix W. Vetter
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Since 2011, there has been a substantial decline in the number of students graduating from college with accounting majors. We help explain this decline by empirically showing that technological advancement is associated with lower relative demand from employers for accounting majors compared to other business majors, especially finance. Specifically, corporate software investment is associated with lower relative wages and employment for accounting majors. Cross-sectional tests point to these findings resulting from differences in demand for human capital associated with specific college majors. As the wage gap between finance and accounting majors widens, fewer students subsequently choose an accounting major and more choose a finance major, consistent with selection models going back to Roy (1951). Our findings illustrate the utility of incorporating human capital demand factors into analyses of accounting labor markets and their connection to college major choice.
abstract_zh: 自2011年以来，会计专业本科毕业生人数显著下降。我们通过实证研究帮助解释这一现象，表明技术进步与雇主对会计专业相对于其他商科专业（尤其是金融专业）的较低相对需求相关联。具体而言，企业软件投资与会计专业毕业生的相对工资和就业机会下降有关。横截面测试表明，这些发现源于对不同大学专业所对应人力资本需求的差异。随着金融与会计专业间工资差距扩大，选择会计专业的学生随之减少，而选择金融专业的学生增多，这与自Roy（1951）以来的选择模型相符。我们的研究结果凸显了将人力资本需求因素纳入会计劳动力市场分析及其与大学专业选择关联的实用性。

title: Bank Deposit Pricing in the Euro Area
title_zh: 欧元区银行存款定价
title_primary: 欧元区银行存款定价
title_secondary: Bank Deposit Pricing in the Euro Area
authors: Ugo Albertazzi, Finn Faber, Alessandro Gavazza, Oana-Maria Georgescu, Ernest Lecomte
official: 官方在线 2026-06-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the pricing of bank deposits in the Euro area during 2007--2024. We document that the pass-through of policy rates to sight deposit rates is low, asymmetric, varies across countries, and decreases over time. We estimate an equilibrium model of bank deposit markets, and find that depositors' price sensitivity exhibits large heterogeneity across EU markets and over time. Rate-sensitive depositors switched to higher-yielding savings products, decreasing the rate-sensitivity of the remaining pool of sight deposits and increasing banks' market power, accounting for the sluggish pass-through following the 2022 European Central Bank's rate hikes.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了2007至2024年欧元区银行存款的定价机制。我们记录到，政策利率向活期存款利率的传导呈现低水平、非对称性、跨国差异显著且随时间递减的特征。通过构建银行存款市场均衡模型进行估计，发现存款人的价格敏感度在欧盟各市场及不同时期存在显著异质性。对利率敏感的存款人转向收益率更高的储蓄产品，导致剩余活期存款池的利率敏感度下降，银行市场势力增强，这解释了2022年欧洲央行加息后传导机制迟滞的现象。

title: A New Wave of Industrial Policy in Asia-Pacific: Could Resurgence lead to Structural Transformation?
title_zh: 亚太地区产业政策新浪潮：复苏能否引领结构转型？
title_primary: 亚太地区产业政策新浪潮：复苏能否引领结构转型？
title_secondary: A New Wave of Industrial Policy in Asia-Pacific: Could Resurgence lead to Structural Transformation?
authors: Paula Arias & Vanya Georgieva & Rahul Giri & Maria González-Miranda & Mr. Ashique Habib & Anne-Charlotte Paret & Tatjana Schulze & Arthur Xie & Weining Xin & Yichen Xu & Dilan Yang
official: 官方在线 2026-05-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper provides a first comprehensive assessment of industrial policy (IP) across Asia‑Pacific and its potential to enable structural transformation. Building an IP database for 2009–2024, paired with a rich dataset, the paper documents a large wave of IP interventions. Subsidies dominate, followed by import-limiting measures. Novel applications of machine‑learning and clustering approaches to assess IP targeting suggest that, ex-ante, about three-quarters of IP could align with structural transformation strategies, including relatively safe (“safe-bets”) and risky (“moonshots”) strategies promoting technological upgrading and diversification, and strategies to alleviate market‑frictions and distortions in key sectoral nodes. IP’s ex-post linkages to trade, competitiveness, and domestic firms’ indicators are small and short‑lived; sustained gains that could lead into structural transformation appear only sporadically. Our findings underscore the need for a more parsimonious and carefully‑designed IP—anchored to targeting clear market‑failure rationales and complemented by ambitious structural reforms—potentially enhancing effectiveness and lowering net costs.
abstract_zh: 本文首次系统评估了亚太地区的产业政策及其推动结构性转型的潜力。通过构建2009-2024年产业政策数据库，并结合丰富的数据集，本文记录了大规模的产业政策干预浪潮。其中，补贴政策占据主导地位，其次为进口限制措施。采用机器学习与聚类分析等创新方法对产业政策靶向性进行评估后发现，事前来看，约四分之三的产业政策可能与结构性转型战略相契合，包括促进技术升级与多元化的相对稳健型策略及高风险策略，以及缓解关键行业节点市场摩擦与扭曲的策略。产业政策在事后与贸易、竞争力及国内企业指标的关联性较弱且持续时间短暂；能够持续推动结构性转型的收益仅零星出现。研究结果强调，需要制定更精简且精心设计的产业政策——以明确的市场失灵原因为靶向，并辅以雄心勃勃的结构性改革——从而可能提升政策有效性并降低净成本。

title: Market Segmentation through Information
title_zh: 基于信息分割的市场细分
title_primary: 基于信息分割的市场细分
title_secondary: Market Segmentation through Information
authors: Matthew Elliott, Andrea Galeotti, Andrew Koh, Wenhao Li
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We explore the power that precise information about consumers’ preferences grants an intermediary in shaping competition. We think of an intermediary as an information designer who chooses what information to reveal to firms, which then compete à la Bertrand in a differentiated product market. We analyze the information designs that maximize consumer and producer surplus and uncover systematic differences in how information can be used to intensify or soften competition. Our analysis demonstrates the power that users’ data can endow intermediaries with and speaks directly to current regulatory debates regarding digital marketplaces.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了关于消费者偏好的精确信息赋予中间商在塑造竞争中的力量。我们将中间商视为信息设计者，由其选择向企业披露何种信息，随后企业在差异化产品市场中展开伯特兰式竞争。我们分析了最大化消费者剩余和生产者剩余的信息设计，揭示了信息在强化或缓和竞争方面可被系统性运用的差异。我们的分析表明，用户数据能够赋予中间商巨大力量，并直接回应了当前关于数字市场的监管辩论。

title: Coups d’état and the informal economy
title_zh: 政变与非正规经济
title_primary: 政变与非正规经济
title_secondary: Coups d’état and the informal economy
authors: Ablam Estel Apeti, Dorgyles C.M. Kouakou, Assi Okara, Kolotioloma I.H. Yéo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper analyzes the effect of coups d’état on the size of the informal economy in a large sample of 98 developing countries observed over the period 1993–2020. Using a matched difference-in-differences approach that combines a two-way fixed effects model with entropy balancing, we find that the occurrence of a coup d’état significantly increases the size of the informal economy. This result is robust across a variety of tests, including event-study analysis, propensity score matching, treatment effect methods based on inverse probability weighting, generalized method of moments estimation, fixed-effects regressions, a falsification test, checks for potential omitted variables, alternative data sources for coups d’état, the exclusion of nonmilitary coups, and accounting for coup d’état spillover effects. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the detrimental effect of coups d’état holds for both successful and failed coups and is influenced by structural factors. Specifically, the effect decreases with higher levels of domestic credit to the private sector, remittances, quality of regulation, and net official development assistance received. Conversely, the effect increases with higher real GDP per capita, democracy, unemployment, oil rents, and income inequality. Higher external debt, lower gross fixed capital formation, and erosion of democracy are the main channels through which coups d’état expand the informal economy in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了1993年至2020年间98个发展中国家中政变对非正规经济规模的影响。采用结合双向固定效应模型与熵平衡的匹配双重差分方法，我们发现政变的发生显著扩大了非正规经济的规模。这一结果在多种检验中均保持稳健，包括事件研究分析、倾向得分匹配、基于逆概率加权的处理效应方法、广义矩估计、固定效应回归、证伪检验、潜在遗漏变量检查、政变数据的替代来源、排除非军事政变以及考虑政变溢出效应等。异质性分析表明，政变的不利影响在成功与失败的政变中均存在，并受结构性因素影响。具体而言，随着国内私人部门信贷、汇款、监管质量及收到的官方发展援助净额的提高，该效应减弱；反之，随着实际人均GDP、民主程度、失业率、石油租金及收入不平等的增加，该效应增强。外部债务上升、固定资本形成总额下降及民主侵蚀是政变扩大发展中国家非正规经济的主要渠道。

title: Grain farmers’ marketing channel choice and its economic implications: evidence on chemical input use, production costs, and sales behaviour
title_zh: 谷物农户营销渠道选择及其经济影响：基于化学投入品使用、生产成本与销售行为的证据
title_primary: 谷物农户营销渠道选择及其经济影响：基于化学投入品使用、生产成本与销售行为的证据
title_secondary: Grain farmers’ marketing channel choice and its economic implications: evidence on chemical input use, production costs, and sales behaviour
authors: Xinyue Zhang, Hongyun Zheng, Jingyi Li
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Marketing channel choice plays a crucial role in shaping small-scale grain farmers’ production decisions and sales outcomes, yet empirical evidence remains limited. This study categorizes grain farmers’ marketing channel choices into farmgate (door-to-door), non-farmgate informal, and non-farmgate formal channels. We examine the effects of marketing channel choice on fertilizer expenditure, pesticide expenditure, production costs, and sales frequency. Using a multivalued treatment effects (MVTE) framework with the inverse probability weighted regression adjustment (IPWRA) estimator, we address selection bias and estimate open-access data from the 2020 China Rural Revitalization Survey. Results show that, compared with selling through the farmgate channel, selling through the non-farmgate informal channel is associated with higher sales frequency. Compared with both farmgate and non-farmgate informal channels, selling through the non-farmgate formal channel is associated with lower fertilizer and pesticide expenditures, production costs, and sale frequency. Heterogeneity analysis further shows that these associations are more pronounced among small farms and vary with distance to town. This study offers practical implications for designing market-oriented interventions to strengthen smallholder farmers’ access to formal, organized marketing channels.
abstract_zh: 营销渠道选择在塑造小规模粮农的生产决策与销售成果中扮演关键角色，然而相关实证证据仍显不足。本研究将粮农的营销渠道选择划分为田间地头（上门收购）、非田间地头非正式渠道及非田间地头正式渠道三类。我们考察了营销渠道选择对化肥支出、农药支出、生产成本及销售频率的影响。采用多值处理效应（MVTE）框架，结合逆概率加权回归调整（IPWRA）估计量，我们处理了选择偏差，并基于2020年中国乡村振兴调查的公开数据进行了估算。结果显示，与通过田间地头渠道销售相比，通过非田间地头非正式渠道销售与更高的销售频率相关联。与田间地头及非田间地头非正式渠道相比，通过非田间地头正式渠道销售则与较低的化肥和农药支出、生产成本及销售频率相关联。异质性分析进一步表明，这些关联在小规模农场中更为显著，并随距城镇距离的变化而有所不同。本研究为设计以市场为导向的干预措施，以增强小农户获取正式、有组织营销渠道的能力提供了实践启示。

title: Introducing and Terminating Monetary Incentives in Non-Regenerating Forests: Insights from a Framed Field Experiment
title_zh: 非再生森林中货币激励的引入与终止：来自框架田野实验的启示
title_primary: 非再生森林中货币激励的引入与终止：来自框架田野实验的启示
title_secondary: Introducing and Terminating Monetary Incentives in Non-Regenerating Forests: Insights from a Framed Field Experiment
authors: Nils Christian Hoenow, Gunther Bensch, Michael Kirk
official: 官方在线 2026-06-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In regions with low soil fertility, smallholder farmers often clear forest to sustain agricultural yields. This pattern becomes more problematic where forest regrowth is slow, contributing to local forest loss and global environmental challenges such as climate change and biodiversity decline. This paper presents findings from a framed field experiment that examines how different types of monetary incentives affect forest-clearing decisions in northern Namibia, a semi-arid region with negligible forest regrowth. We implemented a common-pool resource game with 518 smallholder farmers across 25 villages, in which a forest stock declines dynamically based on participants’ clearing decisions, without immediate regrowth. The game spans three periods: a baseline without incentives, an intervention period where participants receive either individual rewards, collective rewards, an individual fee, or no incentives (control group), and a post-incentive phase. This setup allows us to assess both the immediate effects of incentives and their persistence after incentive removal. All incentive types reduce clearing compared to the baseline, but not significantly more than in the control condition, where clearing also declined – an unexpected trend likely linked to features of the dynamic game design. Incentive effects largely dissipate after removal, with no strong evidence of lasting motivational crowding-in or crowding-out. Overall, our results suggest that moderate payments may be insufficient to sustain cooperation in persistent resource dilemmas. More broadly, they highlight the importance of multifaceted analysis including control conditions and careful experimental framing in field-laboratory studies, coupled with caution in generalizing findings to other settings or policy applications.
abstract_zh: 在土壤肥力较低的地区，小农户常通过砍伐森林来维持农业产量。当森林再生缓慢时，这种模式会加剧问题，导致局部森林损失及气候变化、生物多样性下降等全球性环境挑战。本文基于一项框架田野实验，探讨不同货币激励类型如何影响纳米比亚北部（一个森林再生几乎为零的半干旱地区）的森林砍伐决策。我们针对25个村庄的518名小农户开展了一项公共池资源博弈实验：森林存量根据参与者的砍伐决策动态下降，且无即时再生。实验分为三个阶段：无激励基线期、干预期（参与者分别获得个人奖励、集体奖励、个人费用或零激励（对照组））以及激励后阶段。该设计使我们能够评估激励的即时效应及其在激励取消后的持续性。所有激励类型均比基线期减少了砍伐行为，但并未显著优于对照组——对照组砍伐量同样下降，这一意外趋势可能与动态博弈设计特征相关。激励效应在取消后基本消失，未发现持久的动机挤入或挤出效应。总体而言，我们的结果表明，适度支付可能不足以在持续性资源困境中维持合作。更广泛地看，本研究凸显了在田野实验室研究中纳入控制条件、谨慎设计实验框架并进行多维度分析的重要性，同时需警惕将结论推广至其他情境或政策应用。

title: Beyond the Ban—Shedding Light on Smallholders' Price Vulnerability in Indonesia's Palm Oil Industry
title_zh: 超越禁令——揭示印尼棕榈油行业小农户的价格脆弱性
title_primary: 超越禁令——揭示印尼棕榈油行业小农户的价格脆弱性
title_secondary: Beyond the Ban—Shedding Light on Smallholders' Price Vulnerability in Indonesia's Palm Oil Industry
authors: Charlotte‐Elena Reich, Tim Ölkers, Vanessa Bonke, Oliver Musshoff
official: 官方在线 2026-06-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The Indonesian government imposed a palm oil export ban in April 2022 to address rising cooking oil prices. This study explores oil palm smallholders' vulnerability to the policy using descriptive statistics, Lasso, and post‐Lasso OLS regressions. We analyze the perceptions of 382 smallholders in Jambi province and assess how the export ban affected their economic well‐being, including factors shaping pre‐ban sale prices and influencing the ban's price effects. Our findings show that the export ban led to an on average 63% decline in sale prices. Regression results show that households with off‐farm income sources were more resilient, while partially certified farms faced worse outcomes. Our study highlights the need for market‐based interventions and stronger smallholder integration to mitigate the adverse effects of future price shocks.
abstract_zh: 印度尼西亚政府于2022年4月实施棕榈油出口禁令，以应对食用油价格上涨问题。本研究运用描述性统计、Lasso及后Lasso OLS回归方法，探讨油棕小农户对该政策的脆弱性。我们分析了占碑省382名小农户的看法，评估出口禁令如何影响其经济福祉，包括影响禁令前销售价格及禁令价格效应的因素。研究发现，出口禁令导致销售价格平均下降63%。回归结果显示，拥有非农收入来源的家庭更具韧性，而部分认证农场则面临更不利的后果。本研究强调，需采取基于市场的干预措施并加强小农户的整合，以缓解未来价格冲击的不利影响。

title: Contract Remedies and Search Efforts
title_zh: 合同救济与搜寻努力
title_primary: 合同救济与搜寻努力
title_secondary: Contract Remedies and Search Efforts
authors: Roy Baharad
official: 官方在线 2026-05-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Contract theorists routinely assume that opportunities for efficient breach are exogeneous. This prompts the conventional approach to contract remedies, according to which expectation damages are preferred to the disgorgement rule: when ex-post renegotiations are unfeasible, the former regime facilitates efficient breach while the latter deters it. In this paper, I offer a simple model in which two parties to a contract can exert search efforts to locate better contractual alternatives. The endogeneity of efficient-breach opportunities gives rise to a novel outlook on the choice of remedies for a breach of contract. Specifically, this paper opts out of the expectation damages versus disgorgement distinction to offer two new remedies: conditional disgorgement, which ignores each party's breaching or non-breaching status and grants the breach surplus to the party who has located a better contractual alternative; and partial disgorgement, which divides the breach surplus by bestowing a fixed, predetermined share upon each party. I show that these remedies are generally superior to extant regimes in terms of inducing optimal search efforts. The underlying intuition is that under the proposed rules, each party is better off with being either the breaching or the non-breaching party, and therefore, is incentivized to carry out both selfish and cooperative search. This paper likewise makes the inner comparison between conditional and partial disgorgement, deriving conditions for the optimality of each rule. Finally, it discusses the results in light of existing contract doctrine and commercial practice.
abstract_zh: 合同理论家通常假设有效违约的机会是外生的。这促使了合同救济的传统方法，即预期损害赔偿优于返还规则：当事后重新谈判不可行时，前者促进有效违约，而后者则阻碍之。本文提出一个简单模型，其中合同双方可以付出搜寻努力以寻找更好的合同替代方案。有效违约机会的内生性为违约救济的选择提供了新的视角。具体而言，本文超越了预期损害赔偿与返还规则的传统区分，提出了两种新的救济方式：条件性返还，它忽略各方的违约或非违约状态，将违约盈余授予找到更好合同替代方案的一方；以及部分返还，通过向各方分配固定的预定份额来分割违约盈余。我证明，在诱导最优搜寻努力方面，这些救济方式通常优于现有制度。其基本直觉是，在提议的规则下，无论是作为违约方还是非违约方，各方都能获益，因此有动力进行既利己又合作的搜寻。本文同样对条件性返还与部分返还进行了内部比较，推导出每种规则最优性的条件。最后，结合现有合同理论与商业实践对结果进行了讨论。

title: Automation, Migration, and Development: Geography of Job Precarity in South Asia and North Africa
title_zh: 自动化、移民与发展：南亚与北非地区工作不稳定的地理分布
title_primary: 自动化、移民与发展：南亚与北非地区工作不稳定的地理分布
title_secondary: Automation, Migration, and Development: Geography of Job Precarity in South Asia and North Africa
authors: Bhattarai, Keshav, Adhikari, Ambika P.
official: 官方在线 2026-05-12 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This article examines how accelerating automation and the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in advanced economies reshape labor markets across the Global South through interconnected channels of production, migration, and remittances. Drawing on the theories and practices of economic geography, labor economics, and development studies, the analysis conceptualizes automation as a transnational shock that contracts demand for migrant labor while simultaneously amplifying employment precarity in labor-surplus economies. The article advances a geographically grounded framework linking technology adoption in core industries with labor displacement, youth unemployment, and urban labor saturation in South Asia and North Africa. It further highlights the macroeconomic vulnerabilities in developing countries arising from remittance dependence and the role of digital media in shaping youth mobilization and political unrest in their native countries. By integrating comparative regional field evidence with a technology–labor–space framework, the study contributes to economic geography by demonstrating how digital transformation reconfigures development patterns across regions and countries. The findings underscore the limits of technology-led growth strategies in labor-abundant contexts and call for employment-centered digital policies that are spatially differentiated and institutionally grounded. Keywords: automation, artificial intelligence, labor markets, remittances, youth unemployment, economic geography, Global South.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了发达经济体加速自动化和人工智能应用如何通过生产、移民和汇款等相互关联的渠道重塑全球南方的劳动力市场。基于经济地理学、劳动经济学和发展研究的理论与实践，本文将自动化概念化为一种跨国冲击，它既压缩了对移民劳动力的需求，同时加剧了劳动力过剩经济体的就业不稳定性。文章提出了一个基于地理视角的分析框架，将核心产业的技术采纳与南亚及北非地区的劳动力转移、青年失业和城市劳动力饱和联系起来。文章进一步强调了发展中国家因依赖汇款而产生的宏观经济脆弱性，以及数字媒体在塑造本国青年动员和政治动荡中的作用。通过将区域比较实地证据与技术—劳动力—空间框架相结合，本研究展示了数字化转型如何重构区域和国家间的发展模式，从而为经济地理学做出贡献。研究结论揭示了在劳动力充裕背景下技术驱动增长战略的局限性，并呼吁制定以就业为中心、具有空间差异性和制度基础的数字政策。关键词：自动化，人工智能，劳动力市场，汇款，青年失业，经济地理学，全球南方。

title: Exchange Rates and Asset Prices in a Global Demand System
title_zh: 全球需求体系中的汇率与资产价格
title_primary: 全球需求体系中的汇率与资产价格
title_secondary: Exchange Rates and Asset Prices in a Global Demand System
authors: Ralph S. J. Koijen, Motohiro Yogo
official: 官方在线 2026-04-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop an asset demand system to analyze the equilibrium relation between international portfolio holdings and flows, exchange rates, and asset prices across all countries. We introduce a nested logit model of asset demand, for which we develop a new identification strategy by instrumental variables. Averaged across years and issuer countries, the demand elasticities are 27.9 for short-term debt, 3.2 for long-term debt, and 1.2 for equity. These demand elasticities are empirical targets for international macro models that feature inelastic demand to resolve long-standing puzzles in international finance. We use the estimated demand system to decompose the variation in exchange rates and asset prices into portfolio flows and shifts in asset demand to interpret economic events such as the European sovereign debt crisis and to estimate the convenience yields on US assets. In units of annual expected returns, the convenience yield is 1.41% on the US dollar, 2.71% on US long-term debt, and 0.50% on US equity.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个资产需求系统，用以分析全球各国国际投资组合持有量、资金流动、汇率及资产价格之间的均衡关系。我们引入了一个嵌套逻辑模型来描述资产需求，并为此开发了一种新的工具变量识别策略。按年份和发行国平均计算，需求弹性分别为：短期债务27.9，长期债务3.2，以及股票1.2。这些需求弹性为国际宏观模型中应对需求缺乏弹性的情况提供了实证基准，有助于解决国际金融领域长期存在的难题。我们利用估计出的需求系统，将汇率和资产价格的变动分解为投资组合流动和资产需求变化，以解读欧洲主权债务危机等经济事件，并估算美国资产的便利收益。以年化预期收益为单位，美元的便利收益为1.41%，美国长期债务为2.71%，美国股票为0.50%。

title: Climate policies, labor markets, and macroeconomic outcomes in emerging economies
title_zh: 新兴经济体的气候政策、劳动力市场与宏观经济结果
title_primary: 新兴经济体的气候政策、劳动力市场与宏观经济结果
title_secondary: Climate policies, labor markets, and macroeconomic outcomes in emerging economies
authors: Alan Finkelstein Shapiro, Victoria Nuguer
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the labor market and macroeconomic effects of carbon taxation in the energy sector in emerging economies. We build a macro-search model with pollution externalities, endogenous green-energy adoption, salaried-firm entry, and endogenous self-employment. The carbon tax increases green technology adoption in the energy sector and the share of green energy. Under a baseline revenue recycling scheme that transfers the carbon tax revenue to households, the tax raises energy prices, leading to a reduction in salaried firm and job creation, and an increase in self-employment and labor force participation that ultimately generate welfare and GDP losses. Additional model experiments show that the presence of self-employment as a distinct employment category significantly amplifies these losses. However, endogenous green technology adoption can drastically limit the magnitude of these losses. Using the carbon tax revenue to support green energy investment can deliver a decline in energy prices and net welfare and output gains while reducing self-employment.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了新兴经济体能源部门碳税对劳动力市场及宏观经济的影响。我们构建了一个包含污染外部性、内生绿色能源采用、受薪企业进入及内生自雇就业的宏观搜索模型。碳税提高了能源部门的绿色技术采用率及绿色能源占比。在将碳税收入转移给家庭的基准收入循环方案下，税收推高了能源价格，导致受薪企业和就业创造减少，同时自雇就业和劳动力参与率上升，最终造成福利和GDP损失。额外的模型实验表明，自雇就业作为独立就业类别的存在显著放大了这些损失。然而，内生的绿色技术采用能大幅限制这些损失的规模。利用碳税收入支持绿色能源投资，可实现能源价格下降、净福利和产出增长，同时减少自雇就业。

title: Policy cognition and return-home entrepreneurial intention: evidence from China
title_zh: 政策认知与返乡创业意愿：来自中国的证据

title_secondary: Policy cognition and return-home entrepreneurial intention: evidence from China
authors: Zhe Shang Chenhui Zuo Jinyong Guo Wenjing Han School of Government, Beijing Normal University, Beijing, China

abstract_status: 摘要暂未公开，系统将自动重试
